title: The Tests page shows each proof with its item and criterion, and honest states
description: On a fixture install with a merged item whose case passed, a merged item missing its case file, a backlog item with an unwritten case and an item with a manual proof, the served /api/tests read renders each row with its item key, title and criterion; the backlog row is neutral and folded; only the merged-without-case row alarms; failing rows come first; the manual proof is listed with its state.
